# Omitted outline width: reference/spec divergence

Original control generated by `tools/shape_compound_outlines_fixture.py --default-width`.
It removes `a:ln/@w` from all eight rectangle controls and changes the first
solid/dashed pair to single lines. The remaining pairs are thick/thin,
thin/thick and triple. No source document artwork is included.

The reference application opened the exact scratch source `outline-default-width-single.docx`;
the committed DOCX and PDF are unchanged copies. Its PDF sets the single stroke
width to 0.75 pt. Compound outer geometry begins at x=59.625 around the x=60 pt
path, independently confirming the same full width of 0.75 pt (9525 EMU).
The dashed compound run has length 2.25 pt, three times that pen width.

ECMA-376 Part 1 §20.1.2.2.24 describes absent `w` as zero. The reference application instead uses
0.75 pt here. The importer follows the observed native reference default only when no width
is supplied; explicit and theme-inherited widths remain authoritative.
Explicit zero-width compound hairlines remain a separate unsupported case.

`tools/record_compound_outlines.py --default-width` records 5,928 stable reference
pixels and source/PDF hashes. These samples check surrounding artwork and broad
stroke placement; they do not resolve subpixel band widths. The PDF geometry
above and the import unit assertion supply the width evidence.
